# Download GMAE (Gestión del Medio Ambiente Estatal)

INEGI publishes state environmental-management open data as **one ZIP per topic × year** on the GMAE page:

<https://www.inegi.org.mx/programas/gmae/#datos_abiertos>

There is no useful bulk API for these packages. Filenames are predictable, so this script builds the URLs, checks which files exist, downloads them, and (optionally) unzips them under `environmental_data_sources/`.

**URL pattern:**

```
https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/gmae/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_<topic>_cnge<YYYY>_csv.zip
```

Older bundled module (pre-split topics):

```
.../medio_ambiente_cngspspe<YYYY>_csv.zip
```

*Outline:*

1. Define topics / years and helpers.
2. Build a catalog of candidate ZIPs.
3. HEAD-check which URLs are live.
4. Download (and optionally unzip) selected packages.

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)
```

```{r config}
# change to TRUE for this chunk pipeline to download.
download_now <- TRUE # or FALSE
unzip_now <- TRUE
overwrite <- FALSE

# where to save them
out_dir <- here::here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/GMAE_environmental_state_data/d2026")
zip_dir <- here::here(out_dir, "_gmae_zips")
#dir.create(zip_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

base_url <- "https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/gmae/datosabiertos"

# years for split topic packages (CNGE naming)
years <- 2019:2025

# topics present across recent GMAE/CNGE open data 
topics <- c(
  "biodiversidad_y_ecosistemas",
  "cambio_climatico",
  "monitoreo_ambiental",
  "gobierno_medio_ambiente",
  "educacion_ambiental",
  "asentamientos_humanos",
  "administracion_pub_sostenible",
  "auditorias_ambientales",
  "certificacion_ambiental",
  "microgeneradores_residuos_peligrosos",
  "presupuesto_estatal"
)

# more ocean-related subset
ocean_topics <- c(
  "biodiversidad_y_ecosistemas",
  "cambio_climatico",
  "monitoreo_ambiental",
  "gobierno_medio_ambiente",
  "educacion_ambiental",
  "asentamientos_humanos"
)

# set to download when download_now is TRUE
topics_to_get <- ocean_topics
years_to_get <- years
```

```{r helpers}
gmae_zip_name <- function(topic, year) {
  paste0("conjunto_de_datos_", topic, "_cnge", year, "_csv.zip")
}

gmae_zip_url <- function(topic, year, base = base_url) {
  file.path(base, gmae_zip_name(topic, year))
}

# Bundled pre-split environment module (CNGSPSPE).
gmae_bundled_name <- function(year) {
  paste0("medio_ambiente_cngspspe", year, "_csv.zip")
}

gmae_bundled_url <- function(year, base = base_url) {
  file.path(base, gmae_bundled_name(year))
}

url_exists <- function(url, timeout = 20) {
  # Prefer curl if available (cleaner HEAD); fall back to download attempt metadata.
  if (requireNamespace("curl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    h <- curl::new_handle(nobody = TRUE, timeout = timeout, ssl_verifypeer = FALSE)
    ok <- tryCatch({
      resp <- curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = h)
      resp$status_code == 200L
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    return(isTRUE(ok))
  }

  tmp <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(tmp), add = TRUE)
  ok <- tryCatch({
    utils::download.file(url, tmp, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE, timeout = timeout)
    file.info(tmp)$size > 0
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  isTRUE(ok)
}

build_gmae_catalog <- function(topics, years, include_bundled = TRUE) {
  cat_topics <- tidyr::expand_grid(topic = topics, year = years) %>%
    mutate(
      kind = "topic",
      file = map2_chr(topic, year, gmae_zip_name),
      url = map2_chr(topic, year, gmae_zip_url)
    )

  cat_bundled <- tibble()
  if (include_bundled) {
    # Bundled module years seen on GMAE / CNGSPSPE.
    bundled_years <- intersect(c(2018L, 2019L), years)
    if (!length(bundled_years)) bundled_years <- c(2018L, 2019L)
    cat_bundled <- tibble(
      topic = "medio_ambiente_bundled",
      year = bundled_years,
      kind = "bundled",
      file = map_chr(year, gmae_bundled_name),
      url = map_chr(year, gmae_bundled_url)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(cat_topics, cat_bundled) %>%
    arrange(kind, topic, year)
}

download_gmae_zip <- function(url,
                              dest_dir = zip_dir,
                              unzip_to = out_dir,
                              overwrite = FALSE,
                              unzip = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(dir.exists(dest_dir))
  file <- basename(url)
  dest <- file.path(dest_dir, file)

  if (file.exists(dest) && !overwrite) {
    message("Skip (exists): ", file)
  } else {
    message("Downloading: ", file)
    utils::download.file(url, dest, mode = "wb", quiet = FALSE)
  }

  extract_dir <- NA_character_
  if (unzip) {
    # Keep unzipped folder name matching the ZIP stem (INEGI package layout).
    stem <- sub("\\.zip$", "", file, ignore.case = TRUE)
    extract_dir <- file.path(unzip_to, stem)
    if (dir.exists(extract_dir) && !overwrite) {
      message("Skip unzip (exists): ", stem)
    } else {
      message("Unzipping -> ", extract_dir)
      if (dir.exists(extract_dir) && overwrite) unlink(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE)
      dir.create(extract_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
      utils::unzip(dest, exdir = extract_dir)
    }
  }

  tibble(
    file = file,
    url = url,
    zip_path = dest,
    extract_dir = extract_dir,
    zip_bytes = file.info(dest)$size
  )
}

download_gmae <- function(catalog,
                          dest_dir = zip_dir,
                          unzip_to = out_dir,
                          overwrite = FALSE,
                          unzip = TRUE) {
  if (!nrow(catalog)) {
    message("Empty catalog; nothing to download.")
    return(tibble())
  }
  map_dfr(
    catalog$url,
    download_gmae_zip,
    dest_dir = dest_dir,
    unzip_to = unzip_to,
    overwrite = overwrite,
    unzip = unzip
  )
}
```

## Catalog

```{r catalog}
catalog_all <- build_gmae_catalog(topics, years, include_bundled = TRUE)

catalog_selected <- catalog_all %>%
  filter(
    (kind == "topic" & topic %in% topics_to_get & year %in% years_to_get) |
      (kind == "bundled" & year %in% c(2018, 2019))
  )

catalog_selected %>%
  count(topic, name = "n_years") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Selected topics (years in catalog)")

head(catalog_selected, 12) %>%
  select(kind, topic, year, file) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## Check which URLs are live

This can take a minute (one HEAD/request per file). Skip if you already trust the catalog.

```{r check-urls, eval=FALSE}
library(tictoc)

tic()
catalog_live <- catalog_selected %>%
  mutate(live = map_lgl(url, url_exists))

catalog_live %>%
  count(live) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "URL availability")

catalog_live %>%
  filter(!live) %>%
  select(topic, year, file) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Missing URLs (if any)")
toc() # none missing, 17.313 seconds
```

## Download

Set `download_now <- TRUE` in the config chunk, then run this.

```{r download, eval=download_now}
# optional: only keep URLs that respond 200
# to_get <- catalog_live %>% filter(live)
to_get <- catalog_selected

results <- download_gmae(
  catalog = to_get,
  dest_dir = zip_dir,
  unzip_to = out_dir,
  overwrite = overwrite,
  unzip = unzip_now
)

results %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Download results")
```

## Example: read one package straight from a ZIP URL

Useful as a test to see that it all went as planned.

```{r example-read-url}
edu_url <- gmae_zip_url("educacion_ambiental", 2025)
tmp_zip <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")

utils::download.file(edu_url, tmp_zip, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

zip_files <- utils::unzip(tmp_zip, list = TRUE)
zip_files %>%
  select(Name, Length) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Contents of educacion_ambiental CNGE 2025 ZIP")


# |Name                                                               | Length|
# |:------------------------------------------------------------------|------:|
# |catalogos/                                                         |      0|
# |catalogos/cve_ent_cnge2025.csv                                     |    622|
# |catalogos/mpios_cnge2025.csv                                       |    148|
# |catalogos/otro_fin_cnge2025.csv                                    |     44|
# |catalogos/pro_acc_ed_cnge2025.csv                                  |     57|
# |catalogos/rubeduam_cnge2025.csv                                    |    360|
# |conjunto_de_datos/                                                 |      0|
# |conjunto_de_datos/0_indice_cnge2025.csv                            |    346|
# |conjunto_de_datos/educaamb_cnge2025.csv                            |    390|
# |conjunto_de_datos/muneduam_cnge2025.csv                            |  21513|
# |conjunto_de_datos/proeduam_cnge2025.csv                            |  41296|
# |diccionario_de_datos/                                              |      0|
# |diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_educaamb_cnge2025.csv    |    505|
# |diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_muneduam_cnge2025.csv    |    489|
# |diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_proeduam_cnge2025.csv    |   3823|
# |diccionario_de_datos/readme.txt                                    |   1183|
# |metadatos/                                                         |      0|
# |modelo_entidad_relacion/                                           |      0|
# |modelo_entidad_relacion/modelo_er_educacion_ambiental_cnge2025.png |  51227|
# |readme.txt                                                         |   2048|
# |metadatos/metadatos_cnge_2025.txt                                  |   4432|

# read the state level summary table from inside the ZIP
edu_csv <- zip_files$Name[grepl("conjunto_de_datos/educaamb_cnge2025\\.csv$", zip_files$Name)]
educaamb <- readr::read_csv(unz(tmp_zip, edu_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)

educaamb %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "educaamb_cnge2025 (state-level env-ed summary)")

unlink(tmp_zip) # so that it is not saved and deletes the file/directory specified by tmp_zip.
```

## Notes for ocean resilience scores

Strongest GMAE/CNGE topics for an ocean/coastal institutional score:

- `biodiversidad_y_ecosistemas`
- `monitoreo_ambiental`
- `gobierno_medio_ambiente`
- `cambio_climatico` (coastal filter)
- `asentamientos_humanos` (coastal municipalities)
- `educacion_ambiental` (keyword filter; thin marine content)

These are **state program / capacity** data, not biophysical ocean condition.
Filter to GoC states (BC, BCS, Sonora, Sinaloa, Nayarit, Jalisco) and, where `mun*` tables exist, coastal municipalities.)
